contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Return the square root of the mean of a squared and b squared. Square each input by multiplication; add the squares, divide by two, then take the square root.
contract.domain: All numeric arguments are finite and between -1000 and 1000 unless a tighter bound is stated.
contract.outputRole: root mean square of the two samples
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
